note: Evidence artifacts deliberately not registered as ledger claims. Every waiver needs a reason; tests/test_verification_ledger.py enforces that. A waiver is retired when its artifact gets a claim; the closure ladder waiver was retired by m6405 after nine missions of living on the promise that a 'primary claim' existed elsewhere (it did not). m6453 widened the coverage rule from file names to directories: an entry ending in '/' waives a whole benchmark harness (no committed artifact at all), which is how the evidence debt E1-E3 below became visible instead of silent.
